comment: kiln.skills.client (kiln-skills.dll, since 0.2.0-dev.31.13): the local player's skill tree as the client world holds it. Read-only. The game's skilltree_ui (skills/TreeUi, client 26430625 0x318540; it runs every client step for the entity equal to LocalPlayerData+4) fills one 0x44-byte record per tree node in G38UiPlayData's map at +skills/ui.records (bits +0x08, capacity +0x10, keys +0x28, values +0x40): level +0x41 (PlayerSkillsUi.unlockLevel[node.levelIndex] decoded; a plain node reads slot 0), +0x42 the level byte's low bits, unlocked +0x43 (from the mask bits); then copies the masks to +skills/ui.masks, calls PointsSpent (client 0xe7b170) on PlayerSkillsUi's masks and levels (+0x20) into +skills/ui.points_spent and writes available = total - spent (0 when spent >= total) into +skills/ui.points_available. The total at +skills/ui.points_total is player_ui's, from the replicated player attributes. Kiln's screen hook (client.d/skills.json) writes the shadow nodes' records after the program. docs/re/progression.md section 8.
